items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Monk' only as the interviewer's name ('How you doing, Monk?', 'Thank you very much, Monk'). There is no mention of Thelonious Monk the musician or any professional/personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re having a second session with Ignacio. Welcome.
Doing well. We had some issues the first time around and I lost some of your best moments, so, you’re just going to have to be great again.
